title: Data Asset Stewardship Coverage
dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.
app: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=atlan:audit action=asset_updated
| stats latest(has_owner) as has_owner, latest(has_description) as has_desc by asset_qualified_name
| eval documented=if(has_owner="true" AND has_desc="true",1,0)
| stats sum(documented) as documented, count as total
| eval coverage_pct=round(100*documented/total,1)
description: Measures the share of catalogued data assets that have both an owner and a description, a headline governance KPI for catalog completeness.
value: Undocumented, unowned data is ungoverned data; tracking stewardship coverage turns a vague governance goal into a measurable KPI.
implementation: Ingest catalog asset metadata; schedule weekly; chart coverage and set improvement targets with data owners.
visualization: Single-value coverage gauge, coverage trend, table of undocumented assets.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how much of your data has a clear owner and description, so nothing important is left unmanaged.
